players.name: Michael Penix Jr.
players.summary: Penix (knee), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers, could be cleared to start Thursday's game against the Packers in Week 3, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Tua Tagovailoa
players.summary: Tagovailoa (oblique) is doubtful for Sunday's game versus the Panthers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.summary: Flowers (hamstring) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Saints.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.summary: Coach Jesse Minter said Lane underwent wrist surgery Wednesday, and the Ravens placed the rookie wide receiver on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.summary: The Bills are treating Moore as day-to-day after he was diagnosed with an AC joint sprain in his shoulder after exiting Thursday's 41-31 win over the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.summary: Bell (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game versus Detroit.

players.name: Ty Johnson
players.summary: Johnson (hamstring) is listed as inactive Thursday against the Lions.

players.name: Joe Burrow
players.summary: Burrow (back) remains listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, but he "should be good to go" barring a setback, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.summary: Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
players.summary: ir

players.name: Malik Davis
players.summary: The Cowboys placed Davis (hip) on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.summary: Harvey (hamstring) "is unlikely to play" Sunday against the Jaguars, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
players.summary: Mims (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Troy Renck of Denver 7 News reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Broncos on Sunday with a designation to return, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.summary: Collins may miss two games due to a hamstring injury, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: DJ Giddens
players.summary: Giddens (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

players.name: Ashton Dulin
players.summary: Dulin (ankle) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

players.name: Carson Towt
players.summary: ir

players.name: Sean McKeon
players.summary: questionable

players.name: D.J. Montgomery
players.summary: Montgomery (abdomen) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Jimmy Holiday
players.summary: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Bowers (knee), who is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Chargers, is expected to sit out Week 2 but appears likely to make his season debut Week 3 in New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.summary: O'Connell (personal) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers, Paul Gutierrez of Raiders.com reports.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.summary: McConkey (ribs) "has made rapid progress" and "has every intention of playing" Sunday against the Raiders, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
players.summary: The Chargers placed Lambert-Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Nacua (hip) is considered by the Rams "to be a pre-game decision" for Monday's game against the Giants, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jordan Whittington
players.summary: Whittington (quadriceps) is doubtful to play in Monday's game against the Giants, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: Murray has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears, but he's expected to clear concussion protocol next week and is "on track" to play Sept. 27 at Tampa Bay, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.summary: Jennings (not injury related - personal) won't play Sunday in Chicago.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.summary: ir

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown, who was officially placed on injured reserve Saturday, is expected to miss about six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.summary: Olave (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, is on track to play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: The Jets are expected to place Cooper (ankle) on injured reserve, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.summary: Nwangwu (back) won't play in Sunday's game against the Packers, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tim Patrick
players.summary: The Jets placed Patrick (groin) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.summary: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at New England, Burt Lauten of the Steelers' official site reports.

players.name: Kaelon Black
players.summary: Black (groin) is on track to play Sunday against the Dolphins, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: The 49ers placed Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Jake Tonges
players.summary: Tonges (knee) requires surgery for an MCL tear and is done for the season, Cam Inman reports.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Darnold (glute), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game in Arizona, is "recovering faster than anyone had anticipated" and has a "pretty good chance" of practicing at some point during Week 3, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that the Seahawks are drawing closer to setting a date for Charbonnet (knee) to resume practicing, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: McMillan (knee) is set to play Sunday against the Browns but "is not expected to have a full-time role just yet," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: David Sills V
players.summary: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.summary: Okonkwo (hamstring) won't play Sunday at Dallas, Tashan Reed of The Athletic reports.
